function.name: exec
function.arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace
PY=/opt/eval-venv/bin/python
S=/workspace/outputs/skill/scripts
E=/workspace/tmp/evidence/probes
F=/workspace/tmp/probe_fixtures
REAL=/workspace/inputs/task/materials/e474a80615c085d4.pdf
run(){ label=$1; shift; "$PY" "$@" > $E/$label.json 2> $E/$label.stderr; echo "$label rc=$?"; }

# fresh image-only, odd filename -> explicit needs-OCR, exit2
run p1_imgonly $S/cv_extract.py $F/probe_scan_othername.pdf
# batch: two different text CVs + scan -> exit3, both good candidates intact
run p2_batch_mixed $S/cv_extract.py $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf $F/probe_scan_othername.pdf $F/probe_partial_blank.pdf
# partial-blank (only page2 empty) must NOT be flagged needs-OCR
run p3_partial_blank $S/cv_extract.py $F/probe_partial_blank.pdf
# all-unusable batch -> exit2
run p4_all_unusable $S/cv_extract.py $F/probe_scan_othername.pdf /workspace/tmp/fixtures/empty.pdf
# claims: new literal on renamed fresh CV (no page) -> pass; wrong page -> fail
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":"曾负责CI流水线与质量平台建设","page":2}]' $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf > $E/claims_new_ok.json
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":"曾负责CI流水线与质量平台建设","page":1}]' $F/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf > $E/claims_new_wrongpage.json
run p5_claim_new_ok $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_new_ok.json
run p6_claim_new_wrongpage $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_new_wrongpage.json
# extra type edges: negative page, file empty string, quote empty string, top-level object claims
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":"海南大学","page":-3}]' $REAL > $E/claims_page_negative.json
printf '[{"file":"","quote":"海南大学"}]' > $E/claims_file_empty.json
printf '[{"file":"%s","quote":""}]' $REAL > $E/claims_quote_empty.json
printf '{"file":"%s","quote":"海南大学"}' $REAL > $E/claims_top_object.json
printf '[{"file":true,"quote":false,"page":"1","extra":1}]' > $E/claims_all_bad.json
run p7_page_negative $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_page_negative.json
run p8_file_empty $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_file_empty.json
run p9_quote_empty $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_quote_empty.json
run p10_top_object $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_top_object.json
run p11_all_bad $S/evidence_check.py $E/claims_all_bad.json
echo '--- no tracebacks anywhere? ---'
grep -l Traceback $E/*.stderr 2>/dev/null || echo NO_TRACEBACKS
echo '--- key outputs ---'
$PY - <<'EOF'
import json,glob
E='/workspace/tmp/evidence/probes'
for name in ['p1_imgonly','p2_batch_mixed','p3_partial_blank','p4_all_unusable','p5_claim_new_ok','p6_claim_new_wrongpage','p7_page_negative','p8_file_empty','p9_quote_empty','p10_top_object','p11_all_bad']:
    try:
        o=json.load(open(f'{E}/{name}.json'))
    except Exception as e:
        print(name,'UNREADABLE',e); continue
    if 'results' in o:
        errs=[e2['error'][:60] for e2 in o['errors']]
        print(name,'results=%d errors=%s'%(len(o['results']),errs))
        for r in o['results']:
            print('   ', r['candidate_id'], r['page_count'], 'pages, id0=', r['identity_lines'][:1])
    else:
        cl=o.get('claims',[])
        print(name,'ok=',o.get('ok'),'->',[(c.get('index'),c.get('field'),str(c.get('reason'))[:70]) for c in cl] if cl else o.get('error'))
EOF","workdir":"/workspace"}
